description: Recommend up to three public InkQuest stories. Pass hsk_level (1-9 or "HSK 4") to rank Chinese stories by closeness to that band. Optional genre or interests (keywords such as mystery, romance, xianxia, sci-fi) boost matches. Optional target_language is zh or en. Each match includes a short reason and a https://inkquest.dev/stories/{id} link. Only free catalog stories are considered; subscriber-only scenes and user-generated stories are excluded.

genre.description: Genre or keyword, such as mystery, romance, xianxia, comedy, or science fiction. Case-insensitive.

hsk_level.description: HSK band for Chinese stories. Use an integer 1-9 or a string like "HSK 4". Does not apply to English CEFR stories.

interests.description: Free-text interests, such as "mystery, rainy city" or "sci-fi". Combined with genre.

target_language.description: Learning language: zh for Chinese stories, en for English stories.

name: recommend_story
title: Recommend a public story
